sections.body: First, KC's early-down passing against Buffalo's quick-throw coverage. KC passes on 62.3% of second downs [mc1] over 199 plays [mc2], and Kelce (18.0% of targets [mc5]) and Rice (13.9% [mc6]) are the main options. Second, pass protection against the blitz. KC sends five or more rushers on 26.6% of dropbacks [mc7], while Buffalo has allowed a 14.5% pressure proxy [mc9] and a 6.1% sack rate [mc10] over 344 dropbacks [mc11]. With Smith and Moore out, build protection around hot reads. Third, Buffalo's ground game against a crowded box. KC stacks 6.6 defenders in the box [mc12] on 234 run plays [mc13] and still runs 41.1% [mc15] up the middle, so win with blocking angles. Fourth, the deep ball. Worthy takes 17.1% of KC's targets [mc16], so keep a safety over the top on his go routes.
